approvedMarketingReference.role: Published full-body outfit reference on a stage; a marketing composite, not a source sprite.

presentation.assetProcessing: Exact byte copies of the approved paired idle derivatives. No additional resizing, sharpening, degradation or image generation for the comparison.
presentation.scope: Same synthetic character and same source photo through ordinary Rookie and Champion generation. This example is a Fight idle, not an Aura move.
presentation.resolutionNote: 768x1024 is the normalized runtime cell canvas, not the native amount of generated detail. Original and curated raw sheet dimensions are reported independently.
presentation.historicalAssets: All original generated sheets and the original manifest are preserved. Nova and its historical comparison remain unchanged.

playbackDerivative.reason: The first source frame lacked sufficient background margin. Both qualities use the same seven remaining poses plus the same closing hold.
playbackDerivative.operation: Integer crop and copy at native cell size, without retouching, enhancement, or rescaling.
